segments.comment: A Valkyrie wearing an amulet of magical breathing creates a blue jelly, which lands to her south-east, wishes a pool under herself, and puts on a blindfold; she sinks and the underwater display takes over. Five newts are created around her. She force-fights the unseen jelly twice. The first attack reaches uhitm.c do_attack()'s atk_done test (577-580), which calls map_invisible(): the square now remembers an 'I', and allmain.c:432 under_water(0) blanks the drawn square at the end of the turn. On the second attack the test reads levl[x][y].glyph, the remembered 'I', so nothing is drawn; the newts' bites then fill the message line and the --More-- shows the jelly's square still blank. The port read the drawn glyph there and drew a second 'I'. The seed is the only one of 120 consecutive seeds, from 3100, on which water_friction() leaves both attacks on the jelly and the second turn's messages need a --More--; the clock, character and keys were chosen for this path.
